description: This file defines multiple exported API modules for interacting with backend endpoints related to tests, executions, reports, and AI-generated tests. It contains functions that perform CRUD operations, trigger executions, retrieve reports, and generate tests using an API client.

methods.name: list()
methods.description: Retrieves a list of test cases.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific test case by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new test case with the given payload.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing test case identified by ID with the given payload.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a test case by ID.

methods.name: trigger(payload)
methods.description: Triggers a test execution for given test IDs.

methods.name: status(executionId)
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a specific execution by ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific report by ID.

methods.name: byExecution
methods.description: Retrieves reports associated with a specific execution ID.

methods.name: generate(prompt)
methods.description: Generates tests using AI based on a prompt.

ctags.name: list
ctags.pattern: /^  async list() { const { data } = await api.get('\/api\/reports'); return data; },$/

ctags.name: list
ctags.pattern: /^  async list() { const { data } = await api.get('\/api\/tests'); return data; },$/
